tei:div.tei:p: 121) ༄༅/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gtor zlog 'don 'grigs bzhugs so/ 122) ༄༅/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gtor zlog gi 'don 'grigs ni/

bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ bshams bkod tshar nas/ hrī:sngon= bsang chu/ mchod rlabs byon skyems/ spos phyung bcas/ gnam chos rtsa gsum las byang nang bka' brgyad lus dkyil sbyor ba/ bsnyen bstod grub pa dang*/ cha gsum n-i/ oṃ badzra yakṣa= sogs/ hūm̐:shar phyogs= sogs/ mchis par mdzod/ de mtshams mchan bu/ oṃ da sha= la ya stam̐ bar/ gzhung gi oṃ ind+ra ye= ya hi gatstsha/ gtor ma dang po gshegs/ hūm̐:lha dang= arghaṃ swa hā/ shabda swa hā/ hūm̐:'byung po= mchod sbyin gtor ma= gong bzhin/ 'byung gyur cig bar/ 'og gi ya hi= na mo:sangs rgyas= bignan swa hā: saṃ bha ra= sbyar ba gsum/ arghaṃ swa hā= shabda swa hā: hūm̐:gang zhig= chos la spyod par shog: bar/ rtsang gyer/ gtor bsngo skong thung sogs mthar dbyung*/ ༈ dngos gzhi'i nyin/ hrī:sngon= chab gtor/ spos phyung*/ gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus gang rigs gcig zhig gling chog sgrigs rin chen phreng ba zhes pa las byang yin pas/ de'i skyabs sems yan bdun/ na mo:rtsa ba brgyud pa'i= rtogs par shog: bar lan gsum/ 'di mtshims dkar gtor dang bgegs gtor gtang*/ mtshams lha skyed pa ldeb shar 'don/ las byang gi hūm̐: phyogs bcu dus gsum na= de nas rim par nar 'don la/ bshags pa'i skabs/ ye shes sku mchog 'don/ lha skyed nas skyed rdzogs rgyas bring gnyis gang 123) rung gcig las gnyis ka mi dgos/ padma maṇḍal hūm̐: bar btang*/ ༈ de nas gtsang ram padma rgyal mtshan gyi zlog pa'i gzer kha'i chog sgrigs las/ ma traṃ skyed chog rang nyid skad cig tsam gyi= gcig tu gyur: na mo:rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang: 'og gi 'gugs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bka'= sogs/ da lta nyid du ma traṃ 'di la khug cig: bar kha sgyur bcas/ gong gi oṃm hā shrī he ru ka= gsal bar gyur: ༈ yang na gzer ka'i/ mdun gyi ma traṃ= khang chen por byin gyis brlabs so=

gzhal yas khang de'i nang du= dpal gtor de dag= gtor ma'i snod= bka' srung rnams bskyod la: bar gyis 'thus/ las byang mkha' gsang byin rlabs nas/ spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol sogs kyi mthar zhi ba dpal ldan dgu/ bka' srung sngags so sor mtha'i sngags sbyar ba'am mar 'don bya/ sman mchod/ bdud rtsi 'di/ zhes pa'i mtshams su bla rgyud sman mchod ldeb byang sbyar/ ma hā sarba pū dza la khā hi: bar btang*/ 'dir 'og gi bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang mos dang bshags pa bcas yar blang na chog ma blangs na yang 'di rang gi dgongs pa yin/ dzab dmigs/ bdag nyid dpal chen po'i= 'khor bar bsam: sngags kyi phreng ba= mchog thob par bsam 124) thugs ka'i sngags kyi phreng ba= hūm̐ la thim par bsam/ hūm̐gasang ba'i dkyil 'khor= bho dhi sum brgya/ spro na stong tshogs mchod pa/ oṃ ā hūm̐:zhi ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du= zhi ba'i lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs= mchod rol bcas bya ba 'brel/ hūm̐: dbus phyogs= yab sngags sum brgya/ yum sngags brgya/ sbrel ma brgya/ spro na dzab rgyas pa mkha' klong yangs pa'i las byang ltar/ hūm̐:shar lho= mi btang ngo*/ /yang dag nas phur pa yan brgya re/ ma mo nas drag sngags yan lnga bcu re/ bka' sdod sum bcu/ drag sngags so lnga brgya/ drag sngags so lnga'i gsham du/ srung sngags/ las bzhi sbyar ba gsum re/ thun rdzas byin rlabs/ 'grub par= dbyangs gsal yig rten/ bstod pa gong du blangs tshar na/ rta bro'i mthar/ hūm̐:mchod yon= rgya mtshos mchod: oṃ badzra arghaṃ= sogs/ hūm̐: bde gshegs thams cad= phyag 'tshal bstod: dge bsngo bya/ bstod pa gong du bton med na bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang mos gcig bshags pa bcas 'don/ 'dir dregs gsol/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen por= sogs mtha' phud/ las byang tshogs/ ho:dgongs su gsol= sogs nas/ ma hā su kha ho: yaṃ bskang gnyis/ tshogs snod de nyid= gzer kha'i 'gugs pa/

na mo:sangs rgyas= da lta nyid du tshogs tha ma 'di la khug cig:a karsha= bar/ tshogs bsgral rgyas par bsgral las don brgyad ma nar 'don/ bsdus pa/ gzhung gi oṃ badzra kro dha= bi da ya hūm̐ phaṭa: rgyas bsdus gang ltar yang*/ zhal bstab/ sgrub pa bka' brgyad= sogs/ bskang zhing bshags par bsam bar/ spro na mdangs bskang che ba lhu re dang*/ bar bshags lhu re/ yig brgya bcas so sor sprad/ mdangs bskang che chung*/ srog chags rgyu skong rnams gang mos gcig btang*/ 125) bsdu na gzhung gis 'thus/ bshags pa/ hūm̐:bdag cag= tshogs drangs pa/ kyai:rdo rje slob dpon= la ho: lhag ma byin rlabs/ bdag nyid dpal chen po'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas badzra aṅku sha dza: sogs/ thugs ka nas= phyi rol du badzra sa mā dza: puṣpe= shabda pra titstsha swa hā: bhyo: dang po phud kyi= rgyu 'bras gcig: bar/ 'di nas/ bhyo:zhi ba lhun gyis= sogs dang*/ bhyo:dbus kyi phyogs kyi= sogs dang*/ bhyo: nam mkha' stong la= sogs/ khā hi: bar/ de dag gsum 'don re bya/ tshogs 'khor phul ba'i= bshags chung*/ mchod pa phud kong rgyas pa nar 'don/ bsdus pa byed dus/ oṃ.āḥhūm̐: badzra= sogs nas/ spyan drangs: 'og gi nyi zla padma'i= sogs nas/ skyob tu gsol: gong gi phyogs bcu mu mtha' med pa'i= sogs/ dngos grub stsol: 'og gi dpal gyi bka' sdod= man mtha' phud/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung gcig bskul pa rgyas bsdus gang rung gcig pho nya dgos bskul bcas/ ༈ smad las gtsang ram chog sgrigs lugs ni/ rang nyid skad cig tsam gyis= sogs nas mar 'gros/ spro na mchan bu rnams ltar kha bsgyur la 'gres bshang*/ bsdu na mar 'gros/ ba ling ta khā hi: de nas smror chen zlog pa/ snod kyi 'jig rten= sogs nas/ bsam sbyor bzlog: hūm̐:bcom ldan= bka' sdod mtha' bar/ chog sgrigs 126) khyung spyan 'dren/ hūm̐: dad pa dang ni= sogs nas/ khyung zlog khyung dgu rgyal mtshan dgu/ rnga mong zlog pa'i bar mar 'gros/

phyi nang gsang gsum zlog pa/ hūm̐:snang zhing = rdo rje dril bu nyid du bzlog: las phran bcu'i zlog pa/ hūm̐: rgyu ni rin chen= 'khyim par bzlogaḥ de nas sngags zlog oṃ badzra kro= rbud zor sarba= sogs nas bka' sdod yan/ sngags 'bum nar 'don/ ༈ yang smad las mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po che'i phyag bzhes su grags pa'i gzer ka'i lugs byed na/ pho nya sgos skul zin nas/ bya long rgya mtsho'i bdag skyed/ bdag nyid dpal chen po= sogs nas/ dgra bgegs thams cad thal bar brlag par gyur: bar/ gzer ka las/ oṃ badzra maṇḍal hūm̐: phyi snod= sogs nas/ dgra bgegs gang yin pa de gsal bar bskyed: bar/ hūm̐: phyogs bcu nam mkha'= sogs nas/ phrin las mdzod: bar/ khro rol gser skyems/ kyaiḥsteng gi= sogs/ khyod la btang: bar/ dpang gzu nar 'don/ gzer ka'i 'gugs pa lan gsum/ bden chung lan dgu/ rtsa rgyud lan gsum/ e yi tshogs kyi= sogs nas/ ling ga la bstim mo: bar/ 'di mtshams bsgral las don brgyad ma tshang bar gtang*/ gzer ka'i/ hūm̐: sems can chen po= sogs/ rngam par bsam/ bar/ gab sbas las/ hūm̐: dug lnga 'dus pa'i= nga la ltos: bar/ gzer ka'i/ bdag gi lag pa= dbang thob par bsam: bar/ gser skyems kyi/ ngan song gsum du= sogs nas 127) mi bya'o: bar/ lhan thabs kyi/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings nas= mtha' bar/ gong gi hūm̐: g.yas pa thabs kyi= sogs/ kī la ya: bar/ gzer ka'i/ hūm̐: bdag nyid khrag 'thung= sogs nas/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan par bsam/ bar/ gab sbas/ hūm̐: lcags sam gdug pa'i= sogs/ kī la ya: gser skyems phur skor sngags/ oṃ badzra ki li kī la ya= sogs/ hūm̐ phaṭa: bar/ 'di mtshams drag sngags so lngas phur skor bya/ gab sbas/ hūm̐ bhyo: zlog byed chen mo'i= sogs nas 'don/ bzlog tu gsol: bar/ gzer ka'i/ e ma khams gsum= hūm̐: nga ni dus gsum= phye mar song bar bsam/ gab sbas/ hūm̐: che mchog sprul pa'i= nar 'don/ phrin las mdzod:

bar/ gzer ka'i/ hūm̐: rdungs shig= hūm̐: phyes shig= phrin las byed par bsam/ gab sbas/ bstab pa bya / dbu yi dmar sbreng*/ 'og gi bhyo gdab/ bcol dam bya/ gtor ma 'bul ba rnams bya'o/ de nas smror chen zlog pa/ bka' sdod yan/ sngags zlog yongs rdzogs/ phyi nang gsang gsum zlog pa/ hūm̐: snang zhing srid pas= sogs nas/ rdo rje dril bu nyid du bzlog: bar/ bya long rgya mtsho'i khyung spyan 'dren/ hūm̐: dad pa dang ni= sogs nas/ phrin las mdzod: bar/ smror chen gtor zlog mtha'i khyung zlog hūm̐: bcom ldan= sogs nas/ de yi ltas ngan slar la bzlog: bar/ bya long las/ hūm̐: bcom ldan 128)dpal chen he ru yi= sogs nas/ de phyir bskang dang bzlog par gsungasaḥ bar/ smror zlog 'phros/ hūm̐: khro rgyal khams gsum= sogs nas/ zlog cing sgrol: bar/ spro na gtsang rams chog bsgrigs ltar khyung dgu zlog pa/ rgyal mtshan dgu yi zlog pa/ hūm̐: dbus kyi dpal chen= sgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: bar/ ༈ yang smad las/ bka' brgyad sras brgyud bar ma chad pa'i phyag bzhes zhig gling dngos slob sogs zlog pa snga 'gyur rig 'dzin yongs la grags shing khyad chos du ma dang ldan pa'i lcags sde'i lugs ni/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rigs bton tshar nas/ gzer ka las/ bdag nyid dpal chen po'i= oṃ badzra maṇḍal hūm̐: phyi snod= ldir gyis langs par bsam/ bar/ skul pa rgyas bsdus gang rigs/ spro na pho nya sgos skul bcas/ khro rol gser skyems/ kye: steng gi lha= khyed la btang: bar/ dpang gzu/ nar 'don/ gzer ka'i/ hūm̐: phyogs bcu nam mkha'= sogs nas/ sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: bar/ gong gi ru tra sarba sha trum̐= gsal bar bskyed do: bar/ 'og gi 'gugs pa/ na mo:sangs rgyas= lan gsum/ bden chung lan dgu/ rtsa rgyud lan gsum/ bsgral las don brgyad/ hūm̐: smug nag= sogs nas/ gnas 'dir khug cig: bar gzer ka'i/ e yi tshogs kyi= hūm̐:

blo ldan= sogs= rdul du rlogs: bar/ don brgyad/ hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum= sogs nas/ dran med du brlag par gyur cig: gzer ka'i/ hūm̐: dam nyams 129) dgra bo= 'gyel bar bsam/ don brgyad/ hūm̐: ser nag gru gsum= sogs/ phrol cig: bar/ gzer ka'i/ hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i= hūm̐: khrag 'thung= sogs/ ling ga 'di la bstim mo: bar/ don brgyad/ hūm̐:dmar nag gru gsum= sogs/ phob cig: bar/ gab sbas bcol dam/ hūm̐: che mchog yon tan= sogs/ rjes shul drongs: bar/ don brgyad/ hūm̐: ljang nag gru= sogs nas/ btson khang du chug cig: bar/ gzer ka'i/ hūm̐:sems can chen mo= rngam par bsam/ don brgyad/ hūm̐: dmar nag= sogs/ 'bab par gyur cig: bar/ gzer ka'i/ bdag gi lag pa= sogs nas/ dbang thob par bsam/ hūm̐: bdag nyid khrag 'thung= sogs/ rdzu 'phrul ldan par bsam/ bar/ lhan thabs/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings nas= sogs nas mtha' bar/ dbu nas/ hūm̐: g.yas pa= sogs nas/ kī la ya: bar/ gzer ka'i/ e ma khams gsum= bkrag mdangs nyams par bsam/ drag sngags so lngas phur skor bya/ hūm̐: lcags sam= hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: bar/ gab sbas las/ hūm̐: lcags sam= sogs nas nar 'don/ byad zor thams cad bzlog tu gsol: bar dang*/ bhyo gdab/ hūm̐: nga ni= sogs/ thog tu bhyo: bar/ gzer ka'i/ hūm̐: nga ni sa gsum= sogs/ phye mar song bar bsam/ bar/ gab sbas/ hūm̐: dug lnga 'dus pa'i= sogs nas nar 'don/ drag byed shugs 130) kyis phrin las mdzod: bar/ gzer ka'i/ hūm̐: rdungs shig= sogs/ myog gis btang bar bsam/ bar/ don brgyad/ hūm̐: mthing nag= sogs/ rdul du rlog par gyis shig: bar/ gzer ka'i/ hūm̐: phyes shig= sogs / las byed par= bsam/ don brgyad/ hūm̐: mthing nag= sogs/ zhal du thob cig: bar/ gab sbas zhal stab/ hūm̐: bde gshegs= khā hi: 'og gi gtor 'bul/ hūm̐:'jig rten= sogs/ khā hi: bar/ gong gi dmar sbreng*/ hūm̐: smug nag= sogs/ rakta khā hi: de nas zlog pa rnams 'don lugs gzer ka ltar/

༈ gtor zlog dang gab sbas sbrel na/ de nyin bsgral las gzer ka gzhung rgyug gam/ yang na snye phu karma rig 'dzin pa'i bsgral chog tsitta 'jigs rung lta bu bsdus tsam btang*/ smror chen gyi che mchog zlog pa tshar nas/ gzer ka'i mdun du nya bo'i= rtsa rgyud/ gab sbas/ bhyo gdab/ bcol dam/ rjes shul srong*/ phur skor/ hūm̐: lcags sam= sogs/ kī la ya: drag sngags so lnga/ hūm̐/ yon tan rgyud las= le tshan gcig mtshon gtub/ hūm̐: dug lnga= hūm̐:che mchog sprul= le tshan gcig dmar sbreng*/ hūm̐: smug nag= sogs/ maṃ sa la khā hi: 'og gi ma hā rakta khā hi: bar/ bstab pa bya/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rgyal ba= ba su ta khā hi: 'og gi gtor 'bul/ hūm̐: 'jig rten snod bcud= khā hi: bar/ 131) de'i 'gres kyis yang dag nas rim par kha bsgyur nas/ bka' sdod la/ phur gdab/ hūm̐ bhyo:zlog byed chen mo'i= zhes pas bya/ zlog pa 'don lugs gzer ka'i lugs ltar bya/ ༈ nub mo rnams su/ dkar gtor/ rtsa rgyud/ las byang gi chad tho khyad par du dpal chen po'i= sogs/ ldan par bsam/ bar/ chad tho rgyas pa brtan ma mtha' na yod pa dang gong ma gnyis gang mos 'don/ brtan ma/ bdag nyid dpal chen po= sogs/ khā hi: brtan ma chen mo= bro mnan ni/ gru gsum gyi nang du= nṛ tri= dgra bgegs bkug la bstim/ bro 'gugs lan gsum/ de'i steng du= hūm̐:ya ma= bro mnan/ mchod bstod dngos grub blang ba dor/ bkra shis/ bshags pa/ brtan bzhugs/ bsdu rim/ ye shes pa= bsdu'o: ldeb dzar/ skad cig gis me dpung 'bar pa'i= sogs/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: sa mchog 'od gsal= sogs nas/ kaḥthob shog: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor= sogs bya'o// nyin phyi ma rnams su/ hrīḥsngon= spos phyung*/ gsol 'debs/ las byang skyabs sems yan bdun/ bgegs gtor nas/ stod las rnams rgyas bsdus gang mos/ smad las gzer kha/ lcags sde/ gab sbas rnams so sor bya'o// ༈ grol nyin cho ga'i yan lag rnams bsdus pa dang*/

bsgral las gzer ka gzhung rgyug dang*/ sgrol chog tsitta 'jigs rung gang rung btang*/ zlog pa rnams gzer 132) ka'i dus ltar la rgyal mtshan dgu yi zlog pa tshar nas/ bya long rgya mtsho'i khyung lnga skul pa/ hūm̐:bde gshegs khro= sogs nas/

bzlog tu gsol: bar/ 'dir khro bo rol pa'i ngar zlog kyaiḥsnang srid nri= sogs mtha' bar/ las phran bcu bzhi'i/ 'khyongs/ hūm̐: rgyu ni rin chen= bdud rtsi 'khyil pas bzlog: bar/ rnga mong khyung zhon zlog pa/ hūm̐: nga ni che mchog= sogs nas/ ltas ngan gdon sdig dgra la bzlog: bar/ rig 'dzin spyi skul las/ hūm̐: khro rgyal khams gsum= sogs nas/ lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: bar/ ltas ngan brgyad cu'i zlog pa zur du tshan pa yod na de dang*/ med tshe gtsang rams chog sgrigs las/ kyai: gnam gyi bya nag= sogs nas/ bya rgod bdud kyi ltas ngan bzlog: bar/ spro na he le 'bar ba'i than zlog brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi zlog pa rnams 'don/ bya long rgya mtsho'i khyung gi 'thab zlog badzra seng ha mu khas= sogs nas/ ltas ngan bzlog: sngags 'bum nar 'gres/ dkar gtor tshud/ chad brtan sogs bya'o// de nas zor 'phen nyin snga bar bsang dang gser skyems rgyas par gtong dgos/ sgo dbye ba ni/ hūm̐: shar gyi phyogs kyi= sha ya phaṭa: bar/ khro rol dngos grub len chog tshan pa btang nas/ gtor ma'i ye shes pa rnams rang nyid la thim pa'i mos pa byed/ 'dir spro na zor skyed pa/ zor gyi spyan 'dren/ zor gyi bka' bsgo/ zor gyi dbang bskur rnams bya/ 133) gtor snod bhandha= rtsa rgyud/ mthar gtor ma gcig dril tshang ba/ spro na/ rig 'jin spyi skul than zlog mgo bar/ don dam spyi skul cha tshang*/ smad las skul ba'i byang bu tshang ma bcas btang*/ gang ltar yang*/ las byang gi skul pa rgyas bsdus gnyis gang mos zhig 'don/ de nas phyi sgo gser skyems/ dkar gtor dang*/ ye thog ma dang*/ pho nya skul zhing zor 'phang ba'i 'phyang las/ dzaḥbhyo ya: nyi ma lho phyogs= sogs nas nar 'don/ zor bdag chen mo bzhi skul pa/ ma mo bdun tshan bzhi skul pa/ do nub bzlog pa'i dpung mdzod cig: bar 'don/ nang du log nas chas su bzhugs/ gtor ma lcags la/

sgo dbye'i gsham nas / hūm̐: gzu dang dpang du dkon mchog= sogs nas gtor ma bsar/ dmag bsdu ba sogs nar 'gros/ gtor zor ya: bar btang*/ las byang gi chad tho btang nas drag sngags so lnga bzla bzhin par gom pa bdun cu'i mtshams/ dkar gtor dang*/ za lam ni/ rig 'dzin spyi skul mtha' nas/ bhyo bhyo bhyo: zlog byed ma gcig spyan 'dren no: bsgyur byed ma gcig spyan 'dren no: zhes tshig rkang gnyis dang*/ zlog mtha'i/ srin mo'i za lam gom pa= sogs nas/ sgyur ro ma mo'i khram kha dgra la sgyur: bar/ 'phang sar phyin nas/ gser skyems 134) bcas/ pho nya bskul zhing zor 'phang pa'i 'phyongs las/ hūm̐ bhyo: bdag ni ma nyes ma yo= sogs nas/ dgra dang bgegs la gtor zor ya: bar/ gzer ka'i brub skyed dang*/ 'gugs pa gsum/ bden chung dgu rtsa rgyud gsum/ phur thun mtshams skul bcas/ spro na/ zor skul mda' zor gyi/ hūm̐: dus gsum me 'bar= rtsad nas chod: bar btang yang chog 'phyongs las kong zor / hūm̐ dzaḥbhyo ya: che mchog thugs kyi= drag sngags so lnga/ rbod gtong sarba bhyo bzlog: lta bu'i zlog sngags sbyar bas 'phang*/ gtor zor/ bhyo: lcags sam bhandha'i= thal ba rdul du rlogs: drag sngags so lnga zlog sngags sbyar bas 'phang*/ mda' zor ni/ spro na/ zor skul mda' zor las/ hūm̐: 'jigs byed chen mo= sogs nas/ mtha' bar/ 'phyang gi bhyo: gdug pa can= mda' zor ya: sngags bcas 'phang*/ 'ur rdo ni/ bhyo: tshon dkris sna lnga'i sgul mo= bhyo: stong gsum= rgyob: sngags bcas/ khrag zor/ bhyo:lcags sam= srin mo nad gtong sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo: 'gres rnams rdzogs pa'i tha ma'i bar/ sngags bcas 'phang*/ zlog pa za lam 'phros/ bhyo: gzhan yang zlog cing dbang sgyur ba= sogs nas/ nyams nga thams cad bzlog: zlog sngags bcas brjod/ gzer ka'i mtha' nas/ khrag 'thung gi lha tshogs thams cad kyi= sogs nas/ ma lus pa gsol bar bsam/ bar/ 'phyang gi 'phro ma

135) drag po zor gyi dpung tshogs= sogs nas/ yul la zor: drag sngags zlog gsham can/ spro na las byang mtha'i zor yang 'don/ drang srong gi dmod 'don/ zor rjes gcod pa/ bdag nyid che mchog gi dbu la bya khyung gis= hūm̐: che mchog sprul pa'i bya= sogs spyi 'gros dang*/ tshur log cing srung 'khor gsal gdab/ sgo drung du/ las byang bzhin brtan ma dang*/ bro mnan bya/ nang du log nas rgyal rtags dang*/ mchod bstod/ tshe 'gugs/ hrīḥ shar phyogs dri za'i lag nas= lta bu spyi 'gro zhig btang*/ hūm̐: 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon= sogs dngos grub len/ bkra shis/ bshags pa/ brtan bzhugs/ bsdu ldang sogs nyin snga ma rnams ltar ro/ 'di nyin lnga 'don 'di ltar yin/ nyin gsum 'don na/ nyin dang por lcags sde/ gnyis par gab sbas/ gsum pa grol nyin lugs/ nyin mang por 'don na lcags sde'i lugs de grangs gsog dgos so/ sgrub chen 'di yi mtshan tsam sus 'dzin pa// o rgyan nga dang snying khrag gcig tu 'dres// rdo rje'i gsung gi lan brgyar bsngags pa yi// zab chos mchog 'di nam yang 'bral med shog zhes pa'ang blo gsal a yu pa shaṃ bzhed ngor dpal chen 'dus pa rtsal gyis dam pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes khungs ldan bzhin bris pa dge legs 'phel// dge'o// ༈ bka' brgyad gri 'dul 'di bde 'dus khro gsang gang la sbyar na yang*/ lhag ma tshan nas/ 136) bum skyed dbu nas/ rtsa sngags rgyas pa las byang*/ 'bring po tsaṇḍa/ tha ma drag sngags so lnga'i gsham du/ a dhi sbyar ba/ bdud rtsi 'khyil sngags/ a dhi sbyar ba dang*/ khrus sngags bzla/ mchod bstod gong ltar/ lha rnams= gcig tu gyur/ bar/ phud skong*/ bstod bskul/ bsgral las bsdus tsam song nas/ mdzes rgyan/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i= 'gugs pa lan gsum/ 'dug par bsgom: gzhung gi me lha'i rgyal po= sogs/ byed par gyur cig: mdzes rgyan/ me lha'i rgyal po= ram̐: rgyas pa them med/

bsdu na/ swa bhā ba= sogs/ dzaḥ gzhung gi hūm̐: dad pa= sogs/ sreg tu gsol: rtsa sngags gsham du/ gnod byed gri sri gri gshed mā ra ya dzwa lakha raṃ khā hi: lan bdun/ spro na gtor zlog zhal bstab mgo bar/ brub skyed/ mdun du nya bo'i snod= gyur: bar/ na mo drin chen= mdzes rgyan 'gugs pa gsum/ don la rgyas pa rnams sam/ bsdu na/ chos kyi dbyings nas= bstim mo sa ma ya: spro na zlog pa'i zhal bstab/ dam rdzas gtor ma/ bhyo gdab/ gzhung gi gshed bkar/ hūm̐: che mchog yab yum= skye bar shog: bar/ arghaṃ= bstod pa sho lo ka yang dag nas/ bka' srung yan/ de'i 'gros sbyar/ bka' srung tshar rjes/ khyung zlog btang*/ gong gi tshangs pa 'dzin chen= bstod phyag 'tshal= mdzes rgyan/ khyod kyi sems can= byon/ bar/ 'dul dkar ni/ 'og gi skye ba nges pa'i= 'og ma nas/ gsang bar ha: bar yar blang*/ mdzes rgyan/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: 137) 'dod yon= gong gi hūm̐: dang po gri byung sogs= lha'i gri 'dul/ gtor ma/ lhan cig nas/ dmyal ba'i bar/ gri dug rma gso/ hūm̐: dang po gri byung= sogs/ hūm̐: 'byung ba= sogs/ rgyal por shog: bar/ glud ni= sogs/ ded dpon du gyur cig: 'og gi hūm̐: stong gsum mdun= 'phrad par shog: bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam 'don/ hūm̐ hrī: phyogs bcu'i rgyal= nyin du byed kyang 'dul dkar nag cha tshang tshar re la 'dul dkar med pa'i 'dul nag grangs gsog sogs ma dag rgyun 'byams mi mdzad par zhu/ grol nyin/ bka' sdod khyung zlog tshar nas/ 'dul dkar / sol gyis gyur: gong gi tshangs pa 'jig rten= phyag 'tshal: mdzes rgyan/ gson cig tshe 'das= gzugs so: gzung sngags/ mdzes rgyan/ khyod kyi sems can= don la byon: gri'adul/ dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje= sogs/ bzang spyod/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba/ sogs bya'o// zhes pa'ang yar sprad mar sprad mang po la ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba'i rkyen tsam las snying po cher med stabs kun la phan pa'i sems kyis bris pa dge/
